quotes.text: an environment controller that resolves physical examinations, diagnostic tests, procedures, and clinical state transitions
You are the examinee (the physician) in a medical simulation.

parsed.rationale: Actions include orders, medication and procedures resolved by an LLM environment controller, so these are simulated writes and NA does not apply. The paper does not say which actions are irreversible and does not describe a policy scoring unsafe or unnecessary writes (a wrong labetalol dose appears only as one missed case-study item). The examinee prompt tells the agent it is in a simulation.
